verdict.rationale: Evidence only mentions Docker in the context of running a Windows VM (omarchy-docs-12), not as a general-purpose container toolchain (Docker/Podman) ready for developer workflows. The 'Install > Development' menu (omarchy-docs-2) suggests dev environments can be installed but does not confirm container tools ship pre-configured with no setup. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Docker/Podman/container runtime pre-installed and configured for developer use, any independent confirmation of zero-setup container workflows.
